name: Rabsca
description: Rabsca, the Rolling Pokémon, and the evolved form of Rellor. A Bug and Psychic type.
pokedex_entries: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.
An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.
